units.rawText: As I see the sign on the Special Zone that reads "Carnival Dungeon", I push the door open with doubts in my heart.

units.rawText: If I'm not wrong, this place is supposed to be an entertainment area designed by Antonina... I see, so you're in charge of this place, Nascita...

units.rawText: Ahem! O greedy little thief who craves my treasure! You rogue! You pilferer! I will NEVER allow you to take my treasure!

units.rawText: <size=28>...Let's just play along.</size> Indeed, I am here to plunder thine wealth!

units.rawText: And I will never let you get your way.

units.rawText: Hahaha, you shall fall before my minion's speed! <color=orange>For every step you take, it takes two</color>! You will never escape.
